theorem CompactFlatFiniteSubcomplexDiagrams.sourceBarAugmentation_naturality
    (D : CompactFlatFiniteSubcomplexDiagrams Y L l) (n : ℕ) :

      D.sourceBarAugmentation n ≫ l n
